استبعدوا (form X)
# اِسْتَبْعَدُوا (istabʕadū) /is.tab.ʕa.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَبْعَدَ (istabʕada)
# اُسْتُبْعِدُوا (ustubʕidū) /us.tub.ʕi.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَبْعَدَ (istabʕada)
# اِسْتَبْعِدُوا (istabʕidū) /is.tab.ʕi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَبْعَدَ (istabʕada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
